title.en: Chapter 8 — The Sign of the Spy-glass

sentences.ar: دكان المنظار كان مقهى زغير على الميناء.
sentences.en: The Spy-glass was a small tavern on the harbour.
And over its door hung a big spyglass.

sentences.ar: كان مليان بحارة، وصوت وضحك ودخان.
sentences.en: It was full of sailors, noise and laughter and smoke.
I stood at the door, afraid to go in.
And then I saw him.

sentences.ar: كان طويل وقوي، ووجهه كبير ومبتسم.
sentences.en: He was tall and strong, with a big smiling face.
And his left leg was cut off at the thigh.

sentences.ar: وكان يتحرك على عكازه بين الطاولات زي طير.
sentences.en: And he moved on his crutch between the tables like a bird.

sentences.ar: من أول نظرة، فهمت إنه هاد مش الكابتن.
sentences.en: From the first look, I understood that this was no Captain.
The Captain had been dirty and sad and frightening.
And this one was clean, and cheerful, and his voice was pleasant.
I said: are you Mr. Silver?
He said: I am he, my boy.

sentences.ar: وإنت لازم تكون جيم، الكولد الجديد!
sentences.en: And you must be Jim, the new cabin boy!
And he held out his big hand and greeted me.

sentences.ar: وبنفس اللحظة، واحد من الزباين قام وركض عالباب.
sentences.en: And in that same moment, one of the customers got up and ran for the door.

sentences.ar: عرفته من أول نظرة: الكلب الأسود.
sentences.en: I knew him at first glance: Black Dog.
I shouted: catch him!
That is Black Dog!
Silver shouted: who?
Black what?
Harry, after him!

sentences.ar: وقام واحد وركض وراه، بس رجع بلا إشي.
sentences.en: And one man got up and ran after him, but came back with nothing.
Silver said: he is gone.
In my tavern!
I will tell the squire myself.

sentences.ar: وحكى وحكى عن الكلب الأسود وعن الظلم اللي صار.
sentences.en: And he talked and talked about Black Dog and the injustice of it.

sentences.ar: طلعنا سوا عالميناء، وهو بيحكي لي عن السفن.
sentences.en: We went out together onto the harbour, and he told me about the ships.

sentences.ar: كان يعرف كل سفينة، وكل علم، وكل حكاية.
sentences.en: He knew every ship, every flag, every story.
And he laughed, and made me laugh.

sentences.ar: قلت بقلبي: هاد أحسن رفيق بحر بالدنيا.
sentences.en: I said to myself: this is the best shipmate in the world.

sentences.ar: ولما وصلنا عند السكوير، قال: أنا جيم، شفت شو صار.
sentences.en: And when we reached the squire, he said: I am Jim, I saw what happened.

sentences.ar: وحكى القصة زي ما صارت، بالضبط.
sentences.en: And he told the story as it had happened, exactly.

sentences.ar: وقال الدكتور بعد ما طلع: هاد الزلمة معه حق.
sentences.en: And the doctor said after he left: this man is in the right.

sentences.ar: قال السكوير: قلت لك، جون كنز.
sentences.en: The squire said: I told you, John is a treasure.
